name: CLOUDPT
recent: Cloudpoint Technology 近期完成凭单派发，每2股现有普通股获1张免费凭单，凭单已于2026年11月20日上市。公司执行董事兼CEO在闭市期内外均有股份交易记录。最新季度营收环比增长31%，但净利同比下滑24.8%。
notable: 完成免费凭单派发，每2股现有普通股获1张凭单，共发行265,799,989张凭单，并于2026年11月20日上市。
执行董事兼CEO在2026年11月16日至17日期间于闭市期内增持公司股份。
risks: 凭单派发可能带来未来股权摊薄。
最新季度净利同比下滑24.8%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为45,614,000令吉，环比增长31.0%，同比微增0.1%；净利为4,142,000令吉，环比增长109.8%，但同比下滑24.8%；净利率为9.1%，高于上季度的5.7%。

recent_en: Cloudpoint Technology recently completed a bonus issue of free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares, with the warrants listed on 20 November 2026. The Executive Director cum CEO has had share dealings both during and outside the closed period. Latest quarterly revenue rose 31% QoQ but net profit fell 24.8% YoY.
notable_en: Completed bonus issue of 265,799,989 free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares, listed on 20 November 2026.
Executive Director cum CEO acquired shares during the closed period on 16-17 November 2026.
risks_en: The warrant issuance may lead to future equity dilution.
Latest quarterly net profit declined 24.8% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR45,614,000, up 31.0% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net profit was MYR4,142,000, up 109.8% QoQ but down 24.8% YoY; net margin was 9.1% versus 5.7% in the previous quarter.
